theoretical_caps.note: IF caller ALLOWED_INPUT_FIELDS is the 20 efficiency + 8 context keys. KAV/injury/weather/travel/personnel/coach/info are rejected as UNAPPROVED_HL if present. Sunday rest heuristic is 7/7 so rest+situational contribute 0 on these three games. Practical IF envelope ≈ 6.5 + 1.05 + 1.8 = 9.35 before MC noise (rest/situational 0).

data_partial_tests.label_meaning: DATA_PARTIAL is the through-W8 operational status (1/14 complete). It is not a statement that through-W7 ratings are missing or stale.
data_partial_tests.verdict: REJECT DATA_PARTIAL / week-7 vintage as the cause of IF-vs-market compression. Week-7 is the intended pregame vintage for W8. The compression is produced by the W-L→index map + designed clamps + IF contract that zeros KAV/injury/weather/travel, which would still bind if through-W8 were sealed.
